# gitmoap_repository_pipeline_triggers (Data Source)

The trigger configuration in effect for a pipeline at one ref. Answers "will a push to this branch run this pipeline?" without the caller having to reason about globs. The response names the ref it answered for, because a pipeline's triggers are what its author declared *at that ref* and an answer without one would read as universal.

The token needs `pipeline:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "pipeline_id" {
  type = string
}

data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_pipeline_triggers" "api" {
  pipeline_id = var.pipeline_id
  repo_id     = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline id
- `repo_id` (String) Repository id

### Optional

- `ref_name` (String) Full ref; defaults to the repository's default branch

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (List of String) Which merge-request events the trigger responds to. Empty for other kinds of trigger.
- `allow_pipeline_triggered` (Boolean)
- `build` (String) Which commit a merge-request trigger builds: `merge_result` (the default — the commit merging
would produce) or `source` (the source branch's own tip).
- `cron` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `kind` (String) What caused a run to start.
- `ordinal` (Number) The trigger's position in the pipeline's list of triggers, counting from zero.
- `paths` (List of String)
- `pattern` (String) The branch or tag pattern. Absent means every ref of its kind.
- `pipeline_id` (String)
- `ref_name` (String) For a pipeline defined in a file, the ref the trigger was read from. Absent for a pipeline
defined through the API, whose triggers apply to every ref of their kind.
- `repository_id` (String)
- `source_dir` (String) For a pipeline defined in a file, the directory of the namespace that declares it
(`.gitmoap/pipelines/…`). Absent for a pipeline defined through the API.
- `source_sha` (String) The commit a file-authored projection was read at, so a client can say *as declared at
`a1b2c3`* rather than implying the answer is universal.
- `stem` (String) For a pipeline defined in a file, the pipeline's name as its files declare it. Absent for a
pipeline defined through the API.
